verdict.line: You lose if you trade into Garen's Q window before level 6; you win if you survive to Trinity Force and take it to sidelanes late.

brief.thesis: Garen's damage is almost entirely ability-based — Decisive Strike's bonus proc, the Judgment spin, and the Demacian Justice execute — none of which Counter Strike (E) actually blocks, since it only negates basic attacks. That single fact is why Jax sits at 43.8% over 1,177 games here despite a 50% average win rate: the champion's core defensive tool is nearly dead weight against this specific kit until items catch up.

theirWindow.when: Q up, wave pushing into you
theirWindow.what: This is his all-in: Q silence removes your ability to Leap Strike away or Counter Strike proactively, then he free-casts Judgment twice and autos through the silence. Do not stand and trade here — walk to the edge of minion range and let the wave die down instead.

yourWindow.what: Without the silence he can't punish your ability usage, so this is when you actually use Leap Strike to reposition onto him and weave autos for Relentless Assault stacks. Save Counter Strike for when he's about to auto you, not for his spell rotation.

start.why: Measured as the top start at 45.7% over 879 games — the extra sustain matters here because you're absorbing Judgment pokes you can't easily answer, and the damage helps you punish the windows when his Q is down.

boots.why: 72.3% pick rate and the clear damage leader (44.5% over 966 games) because Garen's kit is entirely physical — the flat reduction blunts every auto and spin tick, not just one instance.

core.why: This is your actual power spike against him — empowered autos plus the movement speed proc finally let you dictate when a trade starts instead of reacting to his Q window.
Highest-rate path (60.9% over 110 games) into this item — the on-hit true damage and shield give you a trading tool that doesn't rely on landing Counter Strike.
Directly answers the level 6+ threat: stasis through a committed Demacian Justice cast negates his entire ultimate.

situational.when: he's landing his R and Q bonus damage consistently and you need the healback to survive extended trades
you fall behind early and need raw survivability against his all-in burst instead of more damage
he's building tanky and you need the current-health damage to keep trades relevant

runes.keystoneWhy: This page measures highest (47.1% over the Lethal Tempo alternative's 41.4%), and it fits the actual problem: you're not out-trading Garen early, you're surviving him. Grasp's bonus health and sustain per proc directly counters a lane where his damage is unavoidable and ability-based.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite measures highest here (44.5% over 65.2% pick) — since you're not favored to win extended trades, Ignite gives you the one clean way to punish a Garen who overextends his all-in without a follow-up plan.

playing.title: Track his Q, not your E
playing.detail: Treat Decisive Strike's cooldown as the real lane timer. If it's up, disengage; if it's down, that's your window to trade.

playing.title: Save Counter Strike for autos
playing.detail: E only negates basic attacks — it does nothing to his Q bonus, E spin, or R execute. Use it to punish him for auto-attacking you, not as a reactive panic button against his combo.

playing.title: Never trade below 40% HP pre-6
playing.detail: Demacian Justice scales off your missing health percentage, so a low-HP skirmish at level 6 is a free kill for him even if you'd normally win the exchange.

playing.title: Leap Strike out after his rotation
playing.detail: You don't have the sustained damage to keep extending post-trade, so use Q to reset spacing the moment his Judgment cooldown ends.

playing.title: Hug minions against solo E
playing.detail: Judgment deals bonus damage to isolated targets — staying near your wave denies that bonus entirely.

playing.title: Rush the level 9-11 spike
playing.detail: Prioritize completing Trinity Force over incremental component purchases; this is the first point where your trades genuinely turn even.

playing.title: Play for sidelanes post-13
playing.detail: Once Sundered Sky and Zhonya's are online, look to split and force 1v1s in side lanes rather than contest him directly in skirmishes.

brief.patchCaveat: All items, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch — the tactical reasoning (why Counter Strike underperforms here, the HP% execute threat, the trade timing around Q) is my own read of the two kits, not sourced from OP.GG's tips beyond the single quoted line.

stats.opponentTip: It is difficult to block Garen’s damage even if you managed to block his Decisive Strike (Q). Block Decisive Strike (W) with Counter Strike [E], stun him, and retreat.
